component.name: 7-Zip
component.summary: Compress and extract archives from the command line
component.project_license: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND LicenseRef-unRAR

description.p: 7-Zip for Linux is a console tool for compressing and extracting archives. It creates 7z and ZIP archives, reads many archive formats, and supports password-protected archives, archive integrity tests and file checksums. This package provides the Linux console version, with no graphical file manager.

This unofficial community package downloads the official x64 or arm64 Linux tarball at install time and runs its 7zz binary unmodified. The upstream manual and license notices remain in the installed archive tree. The included unRAR code may not be used to develop a RAR-compatible archiver.

Run flatpak run io.github.ip7z.SevenZip -h for help. For example, create an archive with flatpak run io.github.ip7z.SevenZip a archive.7z input. List it with the l command and test it with t. Extract it with flatpak run io.github.ip7z.SevenZip x archive.7z -oextracted. The application menu entry opens a terminal shell with 7zz on PATH.

Your home folder is accessible, so relative paths work from any directory in it. External drives are not included: run flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media io.github.ip7z.SevenZip to add them. Network, display, device and host-command access are not granted.

ul.li: Allow archives in Documents: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-documents io.github.ip7z.SevenZip
Allow a different archive folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/absolute/archive/folder io.github.ip7z.SevenZip
Undo optional permissions: flatpak override --user --reset io.github.ip7z.SevenZip
